Version 1.5.0 supports accounts that report only a weekly allowance and can recover an expired Codex sign-in.

## Changes

- Support accounts without a 5-hour allowance. The app omits the missing popup section, tray ring, and tooltip entry, then resizes the popup to fit.
- Ask Codex to refresh an expired sign-in. If that fails, the app explains the problem and asks before opening the official ChatGPT sign-in page.
- Ignore model-specific rate-limit buckets so they cannot replace the account's primary allowance data.
- Cancel automatic activation retries when an allowance disappears from the account response.
- Expand coverage for local token fallback, startup registration, popup layout, authentication recovery, and the published executable.

[View every commit included in v1.5.0](https://github.com/MatthiasHeinsius/codex-usage-tray/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0)
